about_the_game:
One Ninja. One Ghost. Endless Chaos.

In Soulbound, experience a thrilling 2D multiplayer platformer where precision meets unpredictability. Engage in fast-paced, asymmetrical PvP battles that keep you on your toes.

Core Gameplay

Asymmetrical PvP Action: One player controls the agile ninja, navigating treacherous terrain, while the other becomes a ghost, possessing enemies to thwart the ninja's progress.

Dynamic Role-Swapping: Upon the ninja's demise, roles switch, ensuring both players experience the thrill of the chase and the hunt.

Procedurally Generated Levels: Each run offers a new challenge with randomly generated stages, enhancing replayability.

Features

Fast-Paced Platforming: Master wall-jumps, dashes, and evasive manoeuvres to outpace your opponent.

Strategic Possession Mechanics: As the ghost, tactically possess various enemies, each with unique abilities, to set traps and ambushes.

Pixel-Perfect Precision: Enjoy tight controls and responsive gameplay that rewards skilful play.

Retro-Inspired Visuals: Immerse yourself in vibrant pixel art that pays homage to classic platformers.

Whether you're a fan of competitive platformers or looking for a unique multiplayer experience, Soulbound offers intense matches filled with unexpected twists. Its blend of speed, strategy, and ever-changing levels ensures no two games are the same.

short_description: Soulbound is a 2D PvP platformer where one player races as a ninja while the other possesses enemies to try and steal their body. It's an ever-changing game of cat and mouse, dash, slash, and slide to maintain control of the ninja and leave your opponent in the dust in this fast-paced showdown!
